# Window markup reference

Window sizing modes, placement, lifecycle events, and window services.

### Window

Receiver: `Window` and derived types (`where T : Window`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AllowsTransparency(bool value = true)` | `AllowsTransparency` | Sets whether the window supports per-pixel transparency (platform dependent). |
| `Borderless(bool value = true)` | `Borderless` | Sets whether the entire native non-client area (title bar and border) is removed. |
| `Build(Action<TWindow> build)` |  | Defines and immediately runs the window's build at the composition site. The callback becomes the build owner (a virtual OnBuild override is then not invoked) and is re-run by Hot Reload when edited. |
| `CanClose(bool value = true)` | `CanClose` | Sets whether the window can be closed, disabling the native close button when false; the default is true. |
| `CanMaximize(bool value = true)` | `CanMaximize` | Sets whether the maximize button is enabled; the default is true. |
| `CanMinimize(bool value = true)` | `CanMinimize` | Sets whether the minimize button is enabled; the default is true. |
| `CreateBusyIndicator(string message = null, bool cancellable = false)` |  | Creates and shows a busy indicator overlay. Dispose the returned IBusyIndicator to dismiss. While active, window content is disabled and closing is prevented. |
| `ExtendClientAreaTitleBarHeight(double value)` | `ExtendClientAreaTitleBarHeight` | Sets the height in DIPs of the custom title bar area; a value above 0 extends the client area into the title bar while keeping the native frame, and 0 restores the default title bar. |
| `FitContentHeight(double fixedWidth, double maxHeight = 1000)` |  | Sets the window to fit content height. |
| `FitContentSize(double maxWidth = 1000, double maxHeight = 1000)` |  | Sets the window to fit content size. |
| `FitContentWidth(double fixedHeight, double maxWidth = 1000)` |  | Sets the window to fit content width. |
| `Fixed(double width, double height)` |  | Sets the window as fixed size. |
| `FullScreen(bool value = true)` |  | Puts the window into fullscreen, or restores it to normal when value is false. |
| `Icon(IconSource value)` | `Icon` | Sets the window icon. |
| `IsToolWindow(bool value = true)` | `IsToolWindow` | Sets whether this is a floating tool window: a thin native title bar with move and close only, excluded from the taskbar, floating above its Owner. |
| `Maximized()` | `WindowState = Maximized` | Sets the window state to maximized. |
| `Minimized()` | `WindowState = Minimized` | Sets the window state to minimized. |
| `OnActivated(Action handler)` | `event Activated` | Subscribes handler to Activated. Occurs when the window is activated. |
| `OnClosed(Action handler)` | `event Closed` | Subscribes handler to Closed. Occurs when the window is closed. |
| `OnClosing(Action<ClosingEventArgs> handler)` | `event Closing` | Subscribes handler to Closing. Occurs when the window is about to close; set Cancel to true to prevent it. |
| `OnDeactivated(Action handler)` | `event Deactivated` | Subscribes handler to Deactivated. Occurs when the window is deactivated. |
| `OnDpiChanged(Action<uint, uint> handler)` | `event DpiChanged` | Subscribes handler to DpiChanged. Occurs when the DPI changes. |
| `OnFirstFrameRendered(Action handler)` | `event FirstFrameRendered` | Subscribes handler to FirstFrameRendered. Occurs when the first frame is rendered. |
| `OnFrameRendered(Action handler)` | `event FrameRendered` | Subscribes handler to FrameRendered. Occurs after each frame is rendered. |
| `OnLoaded(Action handler)` | `event Loaded` | Subscribes handler to Loaded. Occurs when the window is loaded and ready. |
| `OnPreviewKeyDown(Action<KeyEventArgs> handler)` | `event PreviewKeyDown` | Subscribes handler to PreviewKeyDown. Occurs before the focused element receives a key press; a handled event is not delivered to it and the text input the keystroke would produce is dropped. |
| `OnPreviewKeyUp(Action<KeyEventArgs> handler)` | `event PreviewKeyUp` | Subscribes handler to PreviewKeyUp. Occurs before the focused element receives a key release; a handled event is not delivered to it. |
| `OnPreviewTextCompositionEnd(Action<TextCompositionEventArgs> handler)` | `event PreviewTextCompositionEnd` | Subscribes handler to PreviewTextCompositionEnd. Occurs before the focused element receives the end of an IME composition; a handled event is not delivered to it. |
| `OnPreviewTextCompositionStart(Action<TextCompositionEventArgs> handler)` | `event PreviewTextCompositionStart` | Subscribes handler to PreviewTextCompositionStart. Occurs before the focused element receives the start of an IME composition; a handled event is not delivered to it. |
| `OnPreviewTextCompositionUpdate(Action<TextCompositionEventArgs> handler)` | `event PreviewTextCompositionUpdate` | Subscribes handler to PreviewTextCompositionUpdate. Occurs before the focused element receives an IME composition update; a handled event is not delivered to it. |
| `OnPreviewTextInput(Action<TextInputEventArgs> handler)` | `event PreviewTextInput` | Subscribes handler to PreviewTextInput. Occurs before the focused element receives text input; a handled event is not delivered to it. |
| `OnSizeChanged(Action<Size> handler)` | `event ClientSizeChanged` | Adds a client size changed event handler. |
| `OnThemeChanged(Action<Theme, Theme> handler)` | `event ThemeChanged` | Subscribes handler to ThemeChanged. Occurs when the theme changes. |
| `OnWindowStateChanged(Action<WindowState> handler)` | `event WindowStateChanged` | Subscribes handler to WindowStateChanged. Raised when WindowState changes. |
| `PlatformOptions(PlatformWindowOptions value)` | `PlatformOptions` | Sets the platform-specific window options; options for a mismatched platform throw InvalidOperationException at backend attach time. |
| `Resizable(double width, double height, double minWidth = 0, double minHeight = 0, double maxWidth = double.PositiveInfinity, double maxHeight = double.PositiveInfinity)` |  | Sets the window as resizable with optional min/max constraints. |
| `ShowInTaskbar(bool value = true)` | `ShowInTaskbar` | Sets whether the window appears in the taskbar. |
| `ShowToast(string text)` |  | Shows a toast notification that auto-dismisses after a duration based on text length. |
| `StartCenterOwner()` | `StartupLocation = CenterOwner` | Sets the window to open centered on the owner window. The owner is provided when calling Show or ShowDialogAsync. |
| `StartCenterScreen()` | `StartupLocation = CenterScreen` | Sets the window to open centered on the primary screen. Must be called before Show. |
| `StartManualPosition(double leftDip, double topDip)` |  | Sets the window to open at the specified position in DIPs (primary monitor DPI basis). Must be called before Show. |
| `StartupLocation(WindowStartupLocation value)` | `StartupLocation` | Sets the initial window placement behavior, which must be set before Show is called. |
| `Title(string value)` | `Title` | Sets the window title. |
| `Topmost(bool value = true)` | `Topmost` | Sets whether the window stays on top of other windows. |
| `UseLayoutRounding(bool value = true)` | `UseLayoutRounding` | Sets whether layout rounding is enabled. |
| `WindowState(WindowState value)` | `WindowState` | Sets the window display state. |
